dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Large, irregular 'O' shaped rings concentrated in the mid-dorsal region. Perimeters show a high-contrast transition from dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey/white ring, approximately 20-30 pixels wide, with some inner regions reverting to a darker grey.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-grey circular blobs localized in the anterior-dorsal region, particularly surrounding the larger rings and near the flipper base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An irregular triangular cluster formed by the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli situated in the central third of the visible pelt.

other_distinctive_markers: The flipper at the bottom right exhibits four distinct, high-intensity white horizontal bands on a dark background. There is a sharp transition from solid dark fur on the posterior left to high-contrast patterning on the right.
